text: ScientificViews now supports generated byte streams alongside bounded text documents, validates output/receipt membership before writes, verifies source size/digest and complete EOF, rechecks access per 64 KiB, and binds finalized blobs into unchanged receipt encoding. Existing MRI/behavioural view APIs and legacy disclosure/receipt identities are retained. Ordinary check passed 507 tests; shared PostgreSQL streaming tests and isolated source gate pending. This does not close generalized disclosure/profile composition or modality export qualification.
